subject: Recap: POC guardrails, timeline & ownership (next steps)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: POC guardrails, timeline & ownership (next steps)

Alex — thanks for the session today. Quick written recap and a proposed plan so we can lock timelines and owners. Please confirm anything I got wrong and add your IT/security/procurement contacts if different.

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Goal: Validate latency and cost for document search + summarization flows against ~1M doc index (15 concurrent users).
- Success criteria (customer-facing): average 95th pct latency < 350ms for generation at 1024 tokens; end-to-end query precision > 85% on our seed prompts; stable throughput for 15 concurrent sessions during a 2-hour load window.
- Data: ACME will use anonymized product docs for POC; no customer PII in initial run.

Proposed POC plan & timeline (draft):
1) Week 1 (Oct 25–29): Environment & access — sign agreements, security questionnaire, provide sample dataset.
2) Week 2 (Nov 1–5): Deployment — Redwood-hosted POC environment, model selection, baseline perf runs.
3) Week 3 (Nov 8–12): Evaluation — run seeded queries, collect metrics, iterate prompt/quantization settings.
4) Week 4 (Nov 15–19): Wrap & recommendations — final report, cost estimate, next-step proposal.

Preliminary RACI (please confirm):
- ACME Infra (customer): Responsible for providing sample dataset, network policy, and procurement approvals.
- Redwood Solutions Eng (Karthik): Responsible for POC deployment, perf tuning, and test harness.
- Redwood Sales (Vivek): Account lead / Approver for offers and timeline commitments.
- Redwood CS (Marissa): Consulted for onboarding & success criteria validation.
- Redwood Security (Mina): Consulted/Responsible for evidence & SOC/data controls.

Attachments: I attached a one-page POC-eval-template to capture success metrics and a short security FAQ.

Ask / next steps:
- Alex: can you confirm tentative start week (we suggested Oct 25) and share Dawn's security contact + procurement email?
- ACME: confirm the three success criteria above or add any other must-haves.
- Redwood: internal owners listed above to confirm availability.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachment: POC-eval-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-security-faq.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: POC guardrails, timeline & ownership (next steps)

Thanks Vivek — that captures the call well. A couple quick notes from our side:

1) Start week: Oct 25 works for the team. We want a short kickoff meeting on Monday morning (Oct 25) to align stakeholders.
2) Security / data: I'll loop in Dawn Chen (IT Security) — copying her here in a separate email. We will provide an anonymized export of our product docs by Oct 22. No PII in the dataset.
3) Procurement: our procurement mailbox is procurement@acme.com. Our legal team will need the standard MSA + DPA review; procurement timeline is typically ~3 weeks once legal has the documents.

A couple clarification questions for the POC:
- For the throughput test, can Redwood simulate 15 concurrent users from your hosted environment or do you need us to run the load from our side?
- On success metrics: can you add a secondary metric for semantic recall on a 100-query seed set? We use recall > 0.80 as a gating metric.

I'll forward Dawn and procurement separately.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Search & Knowledge, ACME Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0190

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: RACI details + load test ownership question

Quick internal note before we reply to Alex publicly. Two items:

1) Load test execution owner
- We should offer to run the 15-concurrent user simulation from Redwood-hosted POC infra (this keeps test environments consistent and simplifies telemetry). Karthik — can your team stand up the load harness and run it with ACME-provided seeds? If so we mark Redwood SE as Responsible and ACME as Accountable for approving test data.

2) RACI refinement (suggested):
- ACME: Accountable (A) for dataset approval & procurement sign-off; Responsible (R) for providing sample data and validating results against product requirements.
- Redwood Solutions Eng (Karthik): Responsible (R) for deployment, load tests, model/config experiments, and result collection.
- Redwood Sales (Vivek): Accountable (A) for timeline and commercial decisions; Consulted (C) for progress updates.
- Redwood CS (Marissa): Responsible (R) for success criteria capture and final acceptance demo logistics.
- Redwood Security (Mina): Responsible (R) for providing evidence artifacts (logs, config, access controls) and answering ACME security questions.

Karthik: if you can confirm the harness + rough ETA (1 week to instrument once we have data), I will draft the RACI table into the POC template and send a consolidated plan back to Alex and Dawn.

—Marissa

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Agreed POC guardrails, timeline & ownership (actions)

Alex / Dawn / procurement team —

Following internal alignment, here is a consolidated POC plan and explicit ownership we propose. If this looks good, we will schedule the Oct 25 kickoff on Monday 09:30 PT and circulate invites.

Confirmed success criteria (gating):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 350ms at target prompt lengths.
2) Accuracy: Query precision >= 85% on seeded evaluation set.
3) Recall: Semantic recall >= 0.80 on a 100-query seed set (per Alex's request).
4) Stability: No more than 5% variance in throughput across three 30-minute runs under 15 concurrent sessions.

POC Timeline (finalized):
- Prep & legal: Oct 13–22 — exchange MSA/DPA, ACME to provide anonymized dataset by Oct 22.
- Kickoff: Mon Oct 25, 09:30 PT.
- Deploy & baseline: Oct 25–29.
- Tuning & evaluation: Nov 1–12 (iterative with two 30-min load windows).
- Final report & recommendation: Nov 15–19.

RACI (finalized):
- Dataset: ACME (Accountable), ACME (Responsible to deliver).
- Procurement / Contracts: ACME procurement (Accountable), Redwood Sales (Vivek) (Consulted).
- Deployment & load harness: Redwood SE (Karthik) (Responsible), ACME IT (Consulted).
- Success criteria validation & acceptance: Redwood CS (Marissa) (Responsible), ACME Product (Accountable).
- Security evidence & controls: Redwood Security (Mina) (Responsible), ACME Security (Dawn) (Consulted / Approver for access).

Technical note: Karthik confirmed we can run the 15-user simulation from Redwood-hosted infra; we will share the harness and a readme in the drive link below.

Attachments & links: POC-eval-template.xlsx (filled section for success metrics), redwood-security-faq.pdf, drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCdocs

Immediate actions (this week):
- ACME: send anonymized dataset to s3://redwood-poc-acme by Oct 22 and confirm procurement contact for contracts.
- ACME Security: Dawn — please send any additional checklist items or evidence requirements.
- Redwood: Karthik to deliver load harness and initial instrumentation by Oct 22; Marissa will draft the acceptance test checklist and circulate.

If everyone is aligned I will create the calendar invite for Oct 25 kickoff and attach the POC template.

Thanks and looking forward —
Vivek
